title: The $hp$-FEM does not suffer from the pollution effect for piecewise-smooth Helmholtz problems with Gevrey regularity at boundaries
summary: We consider the $hp$-FEM applied to the Helmholtz scattering problem with wavenumber $k$, truncated with a perfectly-matched layer. The scatterer consists of a combination of Dirichlet, Neumann, and penetrable obstacles together with variable coefficients. Provided that the Helmholtz solution operator is polynomially bounded in $k$, all coefficients are piecewise smooth, all boundary surfaces are Gevrey and all coefficients restricted to boundary surfaces are Gevrey together with all their normal derivatives, we show that the $hp$-FEM is quasioptimal when $p\geq 1+\varepsilon \log k$ and…
